# Prince Picker

Prince Picker is a POS and inventory management platform designed specifically for two-wheeler and automotive spare-parts businesses, retailers, and warehouses.

## Product Overview
- **Product Name**: Prince Picker
- **Category**: POS & Inventory Management Platform
- **Target Users**: Two-wheeler spare parts shops, automotive parts retailers, distributors, and warehouse managers
- **Platform**: Web, Progressive Web App (PWA), Android (Mobile & Tablet)
- **Primary Model**: Offline-first local storage operation with cloud sync capability

## Core Capabilities
- **Product & SKU Management**: Organize parts by SKU, barcode, brand, category, MRP, and selling price.
- **Vehicle Compatibility / Fitment Groups**: Group spare parts by compatible vehicle models (e.g. Honda Activa, Hero Splendor, Bajaj Pulsar, TVS Jupiter, Royal Enfield Classic).
- **Barcode Scanning**: Native camera-based barcode scanning for instant billing, inventory counts, and order lookup.
- **Multi-Location Inventory**: Manage inventory across Shop storage (`R1L1B1`) and Warehouse storage (`WR1L1B1`).
- **Per-Location Stock & Thresholds**: Track distinct quantities and low-stock alert thresholds for every individual storage location.
- **Stock Transfers**: Move stock between shop floor and warehouse locations without inventory mismatch.
- **Sales & Credit Management**: Process sales, generate receipts, track customer credit ledgers, and manage balance payments.
- **Orders & Pick/Drop Workflows**: Fast pick-and-drop workflows for order fulfillment on the warehouse floor.
- **Analytics & Reporting**: Daily sales summaries, inventory valuations, low-stock reports, and movement logs.
- **Offline-First Operation**: Full functionality during network outages using local IndexedDB caching.
